name: Lakshmi Electrical Control Systems Limited
about: Lakshmi Electrical Control Systems Limited manufactures and sells control panels and plastic components in India and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Electricals, Plastics, and Wind Power Generation. It offers control panels, electric vehicles chargers, and components for textile machinery and automobiles, as well as commercial tool rooms and smart energy meters. The company serves railways and metro, power and transmission, textiles, EV, automobiles, telecom, defense, machine and tool, FMCG, electrical and electronics, and healthcare industries. Lakshmi Electrical Control Systems Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Coimbatore, India.
